'''Vherr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He commanded [[Camp Kote]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]] and was defeated when a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] infiltrated the camp.

==Equipment==
Vherr had used an [[Wrist blaster/Legends|wrist blaster]] as his weapon of choice and wore gray and green set of [[Mandalorian armor]].
